name: subprocessor-list
title: Subprocessor list
description: The vendors that process customer data for you: purpose, data, location and transfer safeguard, sorted and dated, with a slot for the notify-me form.
docs: Rows are sorted alphabetically for you. location takes one country or several, always as names, never a flag alone. The notice slot is yours: put the notify-me form or a line on how changes are announced there. Below 768px every row becomes a card with the same labels, so nothing is lost on a phone. caption is the table's accessible name, announced on arrival. An empty list says so in words instead of showing an empty table.
